subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

Next month, she __was going to__ the institute to study for a master's degree.
solution:
The correct answer is option 3) is going to.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase** "next month**" indicates a future action.
 
• We **"is going to"** to indicate an action that will take place in the future.
